plan.focus_en: 有时 for “sometimes”, and 一半 for “half”.

items.title_en: Read and read aloud: 姐姐也看球
Guided mission: signing up for a Chinese class

translations: My older sister doesn't really like watching football. Sometimes when I watch at home, she goes to her room to read.
Man United were playing tonight. She sat down and watched with me. I was really happy.
When Man United scored, she jumped up too! We both laughed.
In the end she smiled and said: “Watching football is fun too! I want to watch again next time.”
My workplace is a long way away — it’s an hour on the bus. I earn four thousand kuai a month.
Half the money goes on rent, and food costs a lot too.
Now I often cook at home, and I spend much less.
This month I still have a thousand kuai left! I’m really happy. I want to buy Mum a new phone.

glossary.english: meal; cooked rice (做饭: to cook)

missions.title: At an office reception
missions.goal: Ask for Miss Wang, find out when she's in and leave a book for her.

steps.partner_en: Hello, who are you looking for?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're looking for Miss Wang.

answers_en: When will she be at work?

steps.partner_en: She'll be in at nine tomorrow morning.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if they can give her something for you.
answers_en: Could you give her this for me?
Can I leave this with you?

steps.prompt_en: Say thanks, it's a book for her.
answers_en: OK, this book is for her.

steps.partner_en: OK, I'll give it to her tomorrow.

missions.title: Signing up for a Chinese class
missions.goal: Sign up for an evening Chinese class, say where you're from and pay half today.

steps.partner_en: Hello, what would you like to learn?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want to take a Chinese class.
answers_en: I'd like to take a Chinese class.

steps.partner_zh: 我们有早上的课，也有晚上的课。
steps.partner_en: We have morning classes and evening classes.
steps.prompt_en: Say evening, because you work during the day.
answers_en: Evening — I work during the day.

steps.partner_zh: 好。一个月一千块，今天给一半就行。
steps.partner_en: OK. It's 1,000 a month — just pay half today.
steps.prompt_en: Say OK, you'll pay half today.
Say great, see you on Monday.
